description: Turn learned pricing on or off, choose how new estimates are applied, or turn its email on or off. Only the fields you send change. apply_mode is optional: turning it on without one keeps the saved mode, or else runs in preview (changes recorded, no price moves) until the automatic default is released; mode in the answer says which. auto applies each new estimate at once and announces every change; approve keeps pricing on the last approved estimate until you approve each change with decide_learned_price_change. enabled false keeps the saved mode. Needs a Last Price credential with routing write scope, or the key of the agent that registered an unclaimed workspace, which owns it.

apply_mode.description: auto: each new estimate prices at once. approve: each change waits for decide_learned_price_change.

email_notifications.description: Email owners, admins and admin agents with an inbox about changes.

enabled.description: Price from the learned elasticity. True without apply_mode keeps the saved mode, else runs in preview.

name: set_learned_pricing
